title: ItemStacker
description: Adds a QoL system that merges identical blocks and items into stacks and displays total counts.
body:
### ItemStacker Adds various improvements to block and item merging for better performance and behavior. This mod works on both server-side and singleplayer. --- _Note: ItemStacker modifies the vanilla item merging system and only works in server-side environments and singleplayer._ --- ### Features - Adds item name and stack count information to merged items: ![item name and stack count](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1d4c92ff849c60bc9a0c22f6cfe2ab72bd3f1a8_0.webp) - Improves item merging and makes it faster: ![Merge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89601980f19285ca205058c852ec5e43b4ee1b21.gif) --- ### Mod Version (1.3.x) | Command | Permission | Short Description | |---|---|---| | /itemstacker **settings** | `Singleplayer: everyone / Multiplayer: OP only` | Change settings like radius, delay and more |
General Settings To change a setting, enter `/itemstacker settings ... []`.
| Setting | Description | Default | |---|---|---| | `maxStack` | Maximum number of items that can be stacked together | `32768` | | `mergeRadius` | Radius used to search for nearby items to merge. | `6` | | `mergeDelay` | Delay between merge operations (in ticks). | `2` | | `symbol` | Symbol displayed before item count | `▶` | | `symbolColor` | Color of the item count symbol. | `yellow` |
OP players have all permissions. Singleplayer users can configure everything without additional permissions. --- ### Mod Version (1.2.x) | Command | Permission | Short Description | |---|---|---| | /itemstacker **maxstack** | `Singleplayer: everyone / Multiplayer: OP only` | Set maximum stack size |
